newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Soc.Gen remote member of Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: Soc.Gen remote member of Brussels bourse.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale has obtained remote membership of the Brussels Stock Exchange, the two said in a joint statement on Wednesday.

This would complement the bank's membership of other European bourses, the statement said, adding that Societe Generale currently followed most Belgian blue chip stocks and was already a member of Belfox, the Belgian Futures and Options exchange.

Societe Generale would become the second bank after Dutch financial group Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING) to request remote membership of the Brussels bourse, taking advantage of the full implementation under Belgian law of the European Directives on Investment Services.
Remote members can operate directly in another country's securities market via a secured and computerised link, which makes cross-border trading and investment as easy as for local members.
